description: How the fitted rover body wires to a real microcontroller (the Wiring page): for each part (TB6612FNG motor driver, each enabled sensor, the display module, the camera) every pin and where it goes (MCU pin or 5V / 3V3 / GND / VBAT rail), the power budget per rail, issues found (pin conflicts, missing pins, 5 V signals into 3.3 V pins, duplicate I²C addresses, ESP32 strapping / ADC2 pins) and a ready-to-use pin file (Arduino pins.h, or pins.py with BCM numbers on the Pi). `board` switches the board first: "esp32" (ESP32 DevKit V1), "uno" (Arduino Uno R3) or "raspberrypi" (Raspberry Pi 4/5 40-pin header; analog sensors go through an ADS1115 on I²C, the camera on the CSI ribbon).
name: get_wiring
title: Get wiring
